clinical_text: Findings: coarse facial features; hepatosplenomegaly; corneal clouding; short stature; joint stiffness with claw hand deformity; recurrent upper respiratory infections; umbilical hernia repaired in infancy. Absent: intellectual disability; cardiac valve involvement on last echocardiogram.
notes: Structured phenotype input with two pertinent negatives. The absent intellectual disability is what separates the attenuated form from the severe one, so an implementation that drops negatives loses the discriminating finding.
